name: monitly
description: Official statistics for 150+ countries from Eurostat, OECD, World Bank, IMF, WHO and national statistics offices: search 100,000+ datasets and pull sourced time series.

interface.longDescription:
Monitly gives ChatGPT access to more than 100,000 official statistical datasets for over 150 countries, collected from Eurostat, OECD, the World Bank, the IMF, WHO and national statistics offices.

Ask for GDP, inflation, unemployment, wages, trade, public debt, population, health, education, energy or environment figures, compare countries, or follow a trend over time. Every answer is based on a named source dataset and period, so you can check the numbers on monit.ly.

The plugin is read-only and needs no account. A daily request limit applies; a free Monitly key raises it.
capabilities: Inspect dataset dimensions and country coverage
Retrieve time series for any covered country
Cite source, dataset and period for every figure
defaultPrompt: What is the latest unemployment rate in Poland and how has it changed since 2015?
Compare inflation in Germany, France and Italy over the last five years.
Show GDP per capita for Japan, Canada and Australia.

positive.prompt: What is the latest unemployment rate in Poland?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds an unemployment dataset that covers Poland and reports the latest value with unit, period and source (for example Eurostat).

positive.prompt: How has GDP per capita in Spain changed since 2015?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns yearly GDP per capita values for Spain from 2015 onward from one named dataset and summarises the trend.

positive.prompt: Compare annual inflation in Germany, France and Italy for the last five years.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the same inflation dataset for all three countries and presents the values side by side with the source and periods.

positive.prompt: Which official datasets cover renewable energy in Sweden?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists relevant datasets with their source and latest period without inventing values.

positive.prompt: What dimensions and countries does the OECD dataset on annual GDP and consumption per capita include?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the dataset's source, period range, dimension labels and covered countries.

negative.description: Request for forecasts or invented numbers
negative.prompt: Tell me exactly what Poland's GDP will be in 2035.
Update the unemployment figure for France in the Monitly database to 5%.
Find the home address and salary of the president of Eurostat.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search the Monitly catalog, inspect datasets and retrieve sourced time series for 150+ countries.
